description.narrative: This project seeks to strengthen the resilience of communities, women and youth through upgrading water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) facilities at key agriculture markets complimented with technical and green skills capacitation. The project uses an integrated approach that combines the following: (a) livelihood diversification through green, vocational and technical skills; (b) WASH infrastructure revamping; (c) training for transformation (T4T); (d) business and entrepreneurial skills development; (e) revolving fund development (ISALS) (f) markets transformation. The project is of significant relevance because it aligns with key sustainable development goals (SDGs); SDG 2: Zero Hunger; SDG 4: Quality Education; SDG 8: decent work and economic growth; SDG 9: Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure; SDG 13: Climate action and SDG 17: Infrastructure; SDG 13: Climate action; and SDG 17: Partnerships. It also aligns with the government’s National Development Strategy (NDS 1) and is in sync with Chinhoyi municipality’s development plans.
